notes.title: Summer's Gone - Season 2 - Steam Log #1
notes.content:
Hello, 

It's been a while since I've posted on Steam. However, I decided to make this a habit now. 

From now on, I'll make a post every month or two summarizing what I post bi-weekly on my Dev Logs on Patreon and SubscribeStar. 

Soon, Where it All Began S1 (EA) will be released on Steam. It plays around 20 years before SG, and it's worth checking out if you like SG and its world. 

You might meet some familiar faces.

I've made a news post there, too, with some previews.

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2965230/view/802308936293156361?l=english

Afterwards, I will focus on the rest of S2's Chapter 1. 

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Summer's Gone - Season 2 - Chapter 1 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43335621/0bc19ba6990ca535594e20af22e0e02cbd0ba9c9.png

I must admit that I overdid it with the size of the next update. It will feature around 7000 still images. 
To put this into perspective, Season 1 had 12000 in total. 

So the next Chapter is almost as big as 60% of Season 1.  

I wanted to ensure the new Season was worth playing, but I underestimated the mental load. WiAB's upcoming Chapter 4 is also double the usual size (~4000 still images). 

A reason why I don't post much besides my bi-weekly development logs on SubscribeStar/Patreon, is that after working all day, I have zero social energy left. 

I can't explain it myself as I'm usually quite social. 
Maybe it's just the sheer size of these updates. 

Regarding the languages: 

Spanish is done, but the translator said there are some code bugs. Some strings didn't get added to the translation file. 

I will update Season 1 in the upcoming months, adding the languages and fixing the bugs that were reported to me on Discord. 

Sadly, I cannot gather feedback from the reviews on the game. I can't view my own store page because I live in Germany. 

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 

I recently bought a new Workstation with some very impressive specs, and greatly increased my render output. 

I now have two Workstations that work all day and night. The old one renders animations, while the new one sets up scenes and does still renders. 

I'm no longer limited by the number of renders my Pc can render overnight. It now outperforms me. 

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Here are some non-spoiler previews. (I will keep it SFW, as I still don't know if Steam allows NSFW previews to be posted on a public news post.) 

https://i.ibb.co/PG2wrVfr/Robinio.png
https://i.ibb.co/0jSjwzP4/Strawberry-Chocolate-Bar.png
https://i.ibb.co/JF8hTCqj/Unfortunate.png
https://i.ibb.co/KpHkbmpv/Zara.png
https://i.ibb.co/kV6JMP6j/a214.png
https://i.ibb.co/ymwW0TJ6/Katielein.png
https://i.ibb.co/JWvHgSJc/One-Muffin-To-Milk-Them-All.png

I sometimes post previews on Twitter (X). Check out the timeline, and you might find a few more previews. (Some are NSFW.) 

I'll make more posts on Steam now. 

Take care, guys, and be safe!

- Ocean

notes.title: Summer's Gone - Season 2 - Chapter 1 - Some previews

Hello, 

Three months have passed, and I wanted to give you guys on Steam a quick update on what's happening. 

I post dev logs, previews, and other things once a week on Patreon or Subscribestar, but I will occasionally post a little summary here, too. 

Too much happens every week, as if I could put it all in one news post. That's why I will just post some visual previews of Season 2 - Chapter 1 here.

Steam will receive another bug fix rather soon, and with that, a few new languages will be added. 

The languages we will add soon: 

- German 
- Spanish

- Russian

- French

- Turkish

If there are other languages you'd like us to consider, comment so below. 


- Ocean
